summary: Maryland household: you (single adult) plus your father (72), who lives with you. You own your home. No children, so WIC, TANF, CHIP, CTC, and school meals don't apply. You have access to job-based health insurance, which likely rules out the ACA premium tax credit. Your income and savings are unclear (answers were "not sure" or "don't know"), and it's unknown whether your father receives any income, so I can't confirm eligibility for income-tested programmes. Recommended to apply: SNAP (household of 2, likely eligible depending on income) and Medicaid (your father, age 65+, may qualify depending on income and assets). Not recommended based on what I know: EITC (depends on earnings; worth checking if you have wages), SSI (your father would need low income and under $2,000 in assets). A caseworker should verify income, savings, and your father's benefits before you apply, and check EITC and SSI at that point.
